implications: Rotate the differentiator from RECEIPT to REFUSAL: 'proved or refused' (Statement Proof, GBP 5-15) is the market's actual paid promise. Our claim becomes: a receipt is either independently re-derivable from the artifact with zero trust in gateway/keys/model/CA/revocation, or it is not emitted at all - and the refusal path must be a first-class, observable, countable output, not an error.

KILL every trust-anchor variant explicitly, on today's evidence: mitmproxy ships the CA keys as a feature (343p/93c) and iOS still accepts two forged certs, so signature-by-a-signer and revocation-checked trust are both broken.
